course.title: Unit 5 The weather and us--Lesson C-【例句】
course.description: Unit 5 The weather and us--Lesson C-【例句】

sentences.content: It's cool and cloudy. We can play basketball.
sentences.english: It's cool and cloudy . We can play basketball
sentences.chinese: 天气凉爽多云，我们可以打篮球。

sentences.content: There is heavy rain now. We can't play basketball. But we can read some books.
sentences.english: There is heavy rain now . We can't play basketball . But we can read some books
sentences.chinese: 现在雨下得很大。我们不能打篮球了，但可以读些书。

sentences.content: It's too hot! We can't play football outside.
sentences.english: It's too hot ! We can't play football outside
sentences.chinese: 太热了！我们不能在外面踢足球了。

sentences.content: There is a strong wind. We can't fly a kite.
sentences.english: There is a strong wind . We can't fly a kite
sentences.chinese: 风很大，我们没法放风筝。

sentences.content: I can talk about different weather.
sentences.english: I can talk about different weather
sentences.chinese: 我可以谈论不同的天气。

sentences.content: I can say what my friends and I do in different weather.
sentences.english: I can say what my friends and I do in different weather
sentences.chinese: 我可以讲讲我和朋友们在不同天气下的活动。

sentences.content: I can tell others how people can have fun in different weather.
sentences.english: I can tell others how people can have fun in different weather
sentences.chinese: 我可以告诉别人，人们如何在不同的天气里享受乐趣。

sentences.content: I can read and spell words with "th".
sentences.english: I can read and spell words with " th "
sentences.chinese: 我能认读和拼写含有“th”的单词。
